title: Tangent incompleteness under coupled image transformations: margin reconstruction and decision consequences
abstract: arXiv:2611.28110v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Can accurate responses to individual geometric image transformations recover their combined effect on a classifier's decision? For identity-aligned bilinear resampling, coordinatewise assembly may fail at first order. Projecting the implemented transformation onto a fixed logit-margin gradient, we derive a linear term plus signed absolute-value ridges. An exact even--odd identity and ridge-cancellation conditions characterize the missing information. Under independent parameter laws, a noncancelling off-coordinate ridge obstructs even unrestricted additive fits. The coupled correction has $O(s^2)$ projected error, versus a possible $\Theta(s)$ axiswise defect; transfer to realized network margins requires local smoothness. Projected RMS errors fall by 82.96% on CIFAR-10 and 82.38% on ImageNetV2 relative to axiswise assembly; realized fixed-pair margin RMS errors fall by 39.75% and 42.73%. The representation prospectively identifies nin

translated_title: 耦合图像变换下的切向不完备性：间隔重构与决策后果
translated_abstract: 对单个几何图像变换的准确响应能否恢复它们对分类器决策的组合影响？对于恒等对齐的双线性重采样，逐坐标组装可能在一阶就已失效。通过将实际实现的变换投影到固定的logit间隔（logit margin）梯度上，我们推导出一个线性项加上带符号的绝对值脊结构。一个精确的奇偶恒等式与脊消除条件刻画了缺失的信息。在独立参数律下，一个不可消除的离轴脊会阻碍即使是完全无限制的加性拟合。耦合校正具有 O(s²) 的投影误差，而逐轴缺陷可能达到 Θ(s)；向实际网络间隔的迁移需要局部平滑性。相对于逐轴组装，投影 RMS 误差在 CIFAR-10 上下降 82.96%，在 ImageNetV2 上下降 82.38%；实际固定配对间隔的 RMS 误差分别下降 39.75% 和 42.73%。该表示前瞻性地识别 nin……（原文摘要末尾截断）
tldr: 论文证明对单个几何变换的准确响应无法通过逐轴加性组装恢复耦合变换对分类器决策间隔的组合影响，并提出具有 O(s²) 投影误差的耦合校正方法（较逐轴组装误差降低约82%），同时用奇偶恒等式与脊消除条件精确刻画了信息缺失的机理。
en_tdlr: Individual geometric transformation responses cannot recover the coupled effect on classifier decision margins via axiswise additive assembly; the paper derives a coupled correction with O(s²) projected error versus a possible Θ(s) axiswise defect—cutting RMS errors by over 82%—and precisely characterizes the missing information through an exact even–odd identity and ridge-cancellation conditions.
